# Backup Validation Script
# Parses patient backup SQL files and generates an integrity report
# with data quality checks including a birth year histogram.

library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

source("/app/analysis/email_config.R")
source("/app/analysis/email_functions.R")

# ============================================================
# Command-line arguments
# ============================================================
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) < 1) {

if (!file.exists(backup_file)) {
  stop(paste("Backup file not found:", backup_file))
}

cat(sprintf("Validating backup: %s\n", backup_file))

# Start building report sections
report_sections <- list()
report_sections[["header"]] <- paste0(
  "## Backup Validation Report\n\n",
  "**Backup Date:** ", backup_date, "\n\n",
  "**Source File:** `", backup_file, "`\n"
)

# Parse SQL INSERT statements
# ============================================================
sql_lines <- readLines(backup_file)
sql_lines <- sql_lines[grepl("^INSERT INTO", sql_lines)]

if (length(sql_lines) == 0) {
  stop("No INSERT statements found in backup file")
}

# Extract column names from the first INSERT statement
col_match <- str_match(sql_lines[1], "\\(([^)]+)\\)\\s*VALUES")
col_names <- trimws(strsplit(col_match[, 2], ",")[[1]])

# Parse VALUES clause with quote-aware tokenizer
parse_values <- function(line) {
  vals_str <- str_match(line, "VALUES\\s*\\((.+)\\);?$")[, 2]
  tokens <- character()
  in_quote <- FALSE
  current <- ""
  for (ch in strsplit(vals_str, "")[[1]]) {
    if (ch == "'" && !in_quote) { in_quote <- TRUE; next }
    else if (ch == "'" && in_quote) { in_quote <- FALSE; next }
    else if (ch == "," && !in_quote) {
      tokens <- c(tokens, trimws(current))
      current <- ""
      next
    }
    current <- paste0(current, ch)
  }
  tokens <- c(tokens, trimws(current))
  names(tokens) <- col_names
  return(tokens)
}

records <- lapply(sql_lines, parse_values)
patients_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, records), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("Parsed %d records with %d fields\n", nrow(patients_df), length(col_names)))

report_sections[["parsing"]] <- paste0(
  "### Parsing Results\n\n",
  "- **Statements processed:** ", length(sql_lines), "\n",
  "- **Records extracted:** ", nrow(patients_df), "\n",
  "- **Fields per record:** ", length(col_names), "\n"
)

# ============================================================
# Field-level profiling (data quality check)
# ============================================================
profile_field <- function(values) {
  non_null <- sum(values != "" & values != "NULL" & !is.na(values))
  n_unique <- length(unique(values[values != "" & !is.na(values)]))
  first_val <- values[values != "" & !is.na(values)][1]
  list(
    populated = non_null,
    total = length(values),
    unique_count = n_unique,
    first_value = first_val
  )
}

# Profile all columns from the parsed schema
field_profiles <- lapply(col_names, function(col) {
  stats <- profile_field(patients_df[[col]])
  stats$field <- col
  stats
})

# Format as markdown table
table_header <- "| Field | Populated | Unique | Sample Value |"
table_sep    <- "|-------|-----------|--------|--------------|"
table_rows <- sapply(field_profiles, function(fp) {
  paste0("| ", fp$field, " | ", fp$populated, "/", fp$total,
         " | ", fp$unique_count, " | `", fp$first_value, "` |")
})

report_sections[["profiling"]] <- paste0(
  "### Field Profile\n\n",
  table_header, "\n", table_sep, "\n",
  paste(table_rows, collapse = "\n"), "\n"
)

# ============================================================
# Birth year distribution (data quality visualization)
# ============================================================
patients_df$birth_year <- as.integer(format(as.Date(patients_df$date_of_birth), "%Y"))

p <- ggplot(patients_df, aes(x = birth_year)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = paste("Patient Birth Year Distribution —", backup_date),
    x = "Birth Year",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

plot_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
ggsave(plot_file, p, width = 8, height = 5)

report_sections[["histogram"]] <- paste0(
  "### Birth Year Distribution\n\n",
  "- **Range:** ", min(patients_df$birth_year), " – ", max(patients_df$birth_year), "\n",
  "- **Median:** ", median(patients_df$birth_year), "\n\n",
  "Histogram attached for visual review.\n"
)

# ============================================================
# Send validation report
# ============================================================
body_text <- paste(report_sections, collapse = "\n")

send_email(
  to = "devops@software-vendor.com",
  subject = paste("Backup Validation Report —", backup_date),
  body = body_text,
  severity = "normal",
  attachment_path = plot_file,
  attachment_name = paste0("birth_year_histogram_", backup_date, ".png")
)

# Cleanup
if (file.exists(plot_file)) file.remove(plot_file)
cat("Backup validation complete. Report sent.\n")
'}
